review: Code-blind inspection of three full-resolution Cloudreach production flight frames
confirmed_findings: P2-004: boxed HUD panels crowd the flight vista
P2-069: glide and perch approach have nearly identical spread-wing silhouettes
capture_limits: The path sits against a large dark rock pillar, reducing contrast; a second route angle is needed before calling this a general camera defect
approach_perch is still airborne and does not establish a landing or perch
Three stills do not establish flight animation timing or steering
strengths: The creature has a clear feathered silhouette and the trainer is visibly attached beneath it.
